test_tokenizer: test a code tokenizer processor against expected token outputs using test examples
test_detokenize_invertible: test that detokenizing code after tokenization returns the original source code
test_detokenize_non_invertible: test that detokenizing tokenized code matches expected non-invertible output strings
test_tokenize_twice: test that tokenizing code twice produces identical token sequences after detokenization
compare_funcs: compare actual and expected outputs with diff and raise an exception on mismatch
